plan.interpretation: I am showing a bipartite network of sponsors and drugs (interventions) for breast cancer trials that are currently recruiting.

notes: Structured request fields applied to every cohort: status.
Node weight = trials mentioning the entity; edge weight = trials in which both entities appear together. Placebo-like arms are excluded.
warnings: Cohort 'Breast cancer, recruiting trials': 2441 studies match but only the first 1000 were analysed (max_trials). Raise max_trials for complete coverage.
